has_played.description: Only present when standings are requested for a phase other than 1.

id.description: Only present when standings are requested for a phase other than 1.

GameConfigRules.description: Same as `GameSettings` minus `timezone`, which lives on `GameConfig["settings"]` instead.

LeagueType.description: "s" = system league, "x" = user created league, "c" = auto created league (the ones named "League <id>").

Overrides.description: Per gameweek/chip adjustments to the rules and scoring. All observed values are empty, so the rule and scoring overrides are modelled as partials.
